import numpy as np

_step = 0

# PD gains on normalized torque (actuator gear ~200)
KP = np.array([1.5, 1.5, 1.5])
KD = np.array([0.06, 0.06, 0.06])

LEAN_MAX = 0.12
PITCH_GUARD = 0.15

    _step = 0

        if abs(pitch) > PITCH_GUARD:

            lean = min(lean, q[2])
        target[2] = lean
